Intro Date:
Febuary 17, 2025

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two Fiat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols as shown on Map No. 4-G

in the area bounded by:

A line 24 feet north of and parallel to West 18 Place; the public alley next east of and

parallel to South May Street; West 18 Place; South May Street.
To those of an RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 1819 S. May Street
